_about: Exercise catalogue for HugotFlow (Build Plan §6 step 1). Every exercise uses equipment from Appendix 2 (Hugot Gym list, Oct 2026); substitutes follow the Appendix 2 Equipment Replacement Guide. 'contraindicated' lists the joint/bone limitations (Scope: knee, lower_back, shoulder, hip, ankle, wrist_elbow) the exercise strains; the instructors review this file. Patterns: squat, hinge, lunge, push_h (horizontal push), push_v (overhead), pull_h (row), pull_v (pulldown), core, carry, cardio, glute, arms, mobility, conditioning.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.cue: Brace your core and keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.cue: Feet slightly forward; lower only as far as is comfortable.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the dumbbell close; sit back as if onto a box.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Do not lock your knees at the top; keep your lower back on the pad.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: Move slowly and stop short of a hard lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.cue: Keep your front heel down and torso upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell sumo squat
exercises.cue: Wide stance, toes out, knees follow your toes.

exercises.name: Hip adductor machine
exercises.cue: Use a comfortable range and a slow return.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Keep your hips down; curl slowly.

exercises.name: Stability ball leg curl
exercises.cue: Keep your hips lifted and roll the ball in slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar close to your legs, flat back, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees; push your hips back, flat back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips; stop when you feel the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips with a flat back.

exercises.name: Hip thrust machine
exercises.cue: Chin tucked; squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Kettlebell glute bridge
exercises.cue: Drive through your heels; ribs down.

exercises.name: Cable kickback
exercises.cue: Keep your back flat; move from the hip.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades back; lower the bar to mid-chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Elbows about 45° from your body.

exercises.name: Seated chest press
exercises.cue: Neutral grip; stop before your elbows lock.

exercises.name: Smith machine bench press
exercises.cue: Set the safety stops just above your chest.

exercises.name: Incline chest press
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulders down and back.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.cue: Slight bend in the elbows; hug a tree.

exercises.name: Cable crossover press
exercises.cue: Stagger your stance; press straight ahead.

exercises.name: Assisted dip
exercises.cue: Lower only until your upper arms are level.

exercises.name: Shoulder press machine
exercises.cue: Back on the pad; press without shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cue: Seated, core tight; press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Lateral raise machine
exercises.cue: Raise to shoulder height only.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cue: Light weight; lead with your elbows.

exercises.name: Rear delt reverse fly
exercises.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.cue: Pull the rope towards your eyes, elbows high.

exercises.name: Cable row
exercises.cue: Sit tall; pull to your belly button.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.cue: Chest on the pad; lead with the elbows.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded row
exercises.cue: Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.cue: Flat back; pull to your lower chest.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Hand and knee on the bench; pull to your hip.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull to your upper chest; don't lean back far.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
exercises.cue: Full control on the way down.

exercises.name: High-pulley pulldown
exercises.cue: Kneel; pull the handle to your chest.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.cue: Elbows still at your sides.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.cue: Slow on the way down.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked; straighten without locking hard.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Lower back pressed to the mat; move slowly.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Reach long; keep your hips level.

exercises.name: Stability ball crunch
exercises.cue: Small range; exhale as you curl up.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.cue: Crunch from the ribs, not the hips.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.cue: Short range first; keep your hips tucked.

exercises.name: Stability ball rollout
exercises.cue: Roll out only as far as you can keep a flat back.

exercises.name: Decline sit-up
exercises.cue: Arms crossed; control the way down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.cue: Snap your hips; the bell floats to chest height.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: Stand tall; short, steady steps.

exercises.name: Treadmill intervals
exercises.cue: 1 min brisk run, 1 min walk; stop if your joints ache.

exercises.name: Incline treadmill walk
exercises.cue: Steady pace you can talk at; hands off the rails.

exercises.name: Curved treadmill run
exercises.cue: Short bursts; you set the speed with your stride.

exercises.name: Spin bike intervals
exercises.cue: 30 s hard, 60 s easy; seat at hip height.

exercises.name: Stationary bike
exercises.cue: Easy, steady pace; knees slightly bent at the bottom.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
exercises.cue: Legs, then body, then arms; flat back.

exercises.name: Jump rope
exercises.cue: Small, light hops on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Agility ladder drills
exercises.cue: Quick feet; stay light.

exercises.name: Heavy bag rounds
exercises.cue: Gloves on; 2 min rounds, 1 min rest.

exercises.name: Muay Thai bag rounds
exercises.cue: Gloves on; mix punches and knees at an easy pace.

exercises.name: Mat mobility flow
exercises.cue: Cat-cow, hip openers and thoracic rotations, pain-free range.
